settings.question: What is the minimum wholesale order?
settings.answer: The minimum is 10 suits per design, and most boutiques order 10 to 24 suits per design. You can mix different colours of the same design to reach the minimum, and order as many designs as you like.

settings.question: Who can buy wholesale from Sufias Fashion?
settings.answer: Boutiques, shop owners, online sellers and resellers in Pakistan. Create a free account and request wholesale access on this page; once approved you see wholesale prices and can order directly.

settings.question: Which fabrics and embroidery do you offer?
settings.answer: Embroidered 3-piece suits in winter cotton, khaddar, lawn, chiffon, organza and sheesha silk, with chikankari, thread, cutwork and sequin embroidery. New designs are added every season.

settings.question: Do you deliver wholesale orders across Pakistan?
settings.answer: Yes. Wholesale orders are packed in Lahore and shipped to all cities in Pakistan, including Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan and Peshawar.

settings.question: How do I pay for a wholesale order?
settings.answer: Pay by bank transfer at checkout. After paying, send the payment screenshot on WhatsApp. Your orders and payments are recorded in your own account ledger on sufias.com.
